darwin.notes: macOS 1.2.4: improved M4A and library playback, short-clip export from long tracks, edit-limit guidance, smooth master volume control, compact controls and optional hints.

win32.notes: Windows 1.2.4: expanded audio decoding, immediate streamed playback with genuine progressive waveforms, improved long-file seek/zoom, pitch and click-to-play controls, resizable library columns, and Gumroad download guidance.
